title: Share of North American firefly species at risk of extinction

source.name: Evaluating firefly extinction risk: initial Red List assessments for North America
source.publisher: Xerces Society / IUCN Firefly Specialist Group, PLOS ONE (2021)

notes: Of 132 species formally assessed (77% of the ~172 described species in the US/Canada), 18 (about 14%) were classified Endangered or Vulnerable. Nearly half of assessed species were data-deficient; if those follow the same pattern as the studied ones, Xerces' own published estimate is that roughly 1 in 3 (29%) North American firefly species may be at risk -- the figure the Society itself led its press release with.
